title: Lost Communication With Glow Plug Control Module
plain: Other computers in the car have stopped hearing from the glow plug control module. It helps run part of the engine or drivetrain.
symptoms: Check engine light on
Engine may run poorly, lose power or not start

causes.name: The glow plug control module lost power or ground (blown fuse or bad ground)
Damaged, corroded or loose network wiring or connector
Weak battery or low system voltage
Failed glow plug control module
Another module shorting out the network

checks: Test the battery and charging voltage first
Check the fuses, power and ground for the glow plug control module
See which modules answer a scan tool to narrow down the break
Inspect network wiring and connectors near the module
fix: Restore power, ground or wiring to the glow plug control module; replace the module only after those test good.
